verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਰਸਣੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਇਕ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਜਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: gur dharasan parasan safal chhia dharasan ik dharasan jaanai|

en.bdb: Blessed is the Glimpse and the company of the guru because there only one visualizes God alone in all the six philosophies.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਿਬ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਲੋਕ ਵੇਦ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: dhib dhisaT paragaas kar lok vedh gur giaan pachhaanai|

en.bdb: Getting enlightened one identifies the teachings of Guru even in secular affairs

verses.gurmukhi: ਏਕਾ ਨਾਰੀ ਜਤੀ ਹੋਇ ਪਰ ਨਾਰੀ ਧੀ ਭੈਣ ਵਖਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: ekaa naaree jatee hoi par naaree dhee bhain vakhaanai|

en.bdb: Having one women as wife he (the Sikh) is a celebate and considers any other's wife as his daughter or a sister.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਧਨੁ ਸੂਅਰ ਗਾਇ ਜਿਉ ਮਕਰੂਹ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: par dhan sooar gai jiau makarooh hi(n)dhoo musalamaanai|

en.bdb: To covet another man's property is forbidden (to a Sikh) as the swine is to a Muslim and the cow to a Hindu.

verses.gurmukhi: ਘਰਬਾਰੀ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਿਖਾ ਸੂਤ੍ਰ੍ਰ ਮਲ ਮੂਤ੍ਰ੍ਰ ਵਿਡਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: gharabaaree gursikh hoi sikhaa sootrr mal mootrr viddaanai|

en.bdb: The Sikh being a householder abnegates tonsure, the sacred thread (Janeau), etc. and forsakes them like abominable faces.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: paarabraham pooran braham giaan dhiaan gursikh sin(j)aanai|

en.bdb: The Sikh of the Guru accepts transcendental Lord as the sole found af higher knowledge and the meditation.
In the congregation of such people any body could become authentic as well as respectable.
